text:
Acme-Support: Hey team, customer AcmeCorp reporting a surge of 503s and intermittent timeouts hitting /v1/generate from their EU region starting ~08:30 UTC. SDK shows repeated retries, increasing latency and billing spikes.
Micah: Thanks — can you paste the exact error payloads and SDK version?
Acme-Support: SDK v1.3.2, errors look like `503 Service Unavailable` then `504 timeout` after retries. Attached example log: `{"status":503,"path":"/v1/generate","request_id":"r-cc123"}`
Tara: Any repro steps? Is this only for streaming or also non-streaming?
Acme-Support: Both. Streaming sessions drop mid-response ~p95 and non-streaming calls fail fast after ~12s. Happens across ~120 requests/min from them.
Jules: Weird — hit rate not huge. Is this confined to a single edge or many? Can SRE pull gateway logs for those request_ids?
SRE-Bot: Pulling logs for r-cc123..r-cc148 across eu-west-1. Correlation id map: gw-7312 -> upstream-io-timeout. ETA 6m.
Micah: While we wait: check auth headers length? We had an issue where very long metadata triggered proxy buffer failures.
Acme-Support: Confirmed headers are normal. Token rotates every 10m for them.
Alex: Can you share a minimal curl that reproduces? Also include `--no-keepalive` test to see connection reuse effect.
Acme-Support: Here's what customer ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They also see the error when using our JS SDK with default retry policy.
Priya: From logs: a subset of requests are being routed to a hot upstream where `504` shows `read timeout` from model-worker. Likely transient worker eviction under burst.
Micah: Can we confirm worker OOMs or preemption events around 08:30? Also need KVCACHE lock contention metrics.
SRE-Bot: No OOMs in cluster metrics at that window. Found high per-worker connection count on host i-0abc3343; ephemeral queues hit 95% for ~3m.
Jules: That smells like an edge->worker connection storm; maybe client retries are amplifying cold starts. For mitigation we can: 1) throttle back SDK retry multiplier for that tenant, 2) add transient-capacity fallback to dedicated pool, 3) enable prefix-KV caching to reduce tokens.
Micah: Short-term: set a per-tenant circuit breaker at gateway (5xx rate > 5% over 1m -> 429). Can support apply temporary rule?
Tara: I can push a tenant-scoped circuit-breaker for AcmeCorp in the next 10m, will monitor p95 after.
Acme-Support: Please do. Customer requests ETA and a note to their engineering lead.
Priya: Also reducing SDK default retries from 3 to 1 for a canary rollout might stop amplification. We should communicate recommended SDK config to Acme.
Micah: Agreed. Action items for initial update to customer: - note we observed short-lived upstream read timeouts and connection queuing - applying tenant circuit-breaker now - recommend temporary SDK retry reduction + enable streaming heartbeat (if using streaming) - monitoring 10m and will follow up with root cause.
Acme-Support: Sending this to Acme lead now. They asked for repro steps — provide a small script that toggles retries and keepalive.
Alex: Example script to repro variants:
```bash
# no keepalive, single retry
export RW_TOKEN="<token>"
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN" -H "Connection: close" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Jules: Monitoring update: after circuit-breaker push at 08:47 UTC, 503 rate for Acme requests dropped from 7.1% -> 0.6% in 3m. p95 latency improved ~270ms.
SRE-Bot: Circuit-breaker rule active for tenant acme-123, TTL 30m. Auto-rolloff enabled.
Micah: Good. Next steps: dig deeper into why that worker got connection-saturated: ingest routing patterns, batch sizes, and client connection reuse. Priya, can you capture a heap/profile from the worker pool during repro window if it reoccurs?
Priya: Will set an on-call probe to capture stacks and fd counts if we see another spike.
Tara: I'll draft the customer-facing update: 1) what we saw, 2) temporary mitigation applied, 3) recommended SDK settings, 4) we'll follow up with RCA and long-term fixes. Posting in 5m.
Acme-Support: Customer acked the temporary mitigation and appreciates the quick fix. They will try reduced retries and report back.
Micah: Thanks everyone. Leave this thread open — tag me if the customer sees another occurrence.
Tara: Update posted to customer and internal incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incident/acme-3777777777 (internal). :white_check_mark:
Acme-Support: Closing on our side; will reopen if they see it again. :pray:
